description: This file contains functions and types related to Feishu group and message policies, including allowlist matching, group configuration resolution, and reply policy determination.

methods.name: normalizeFeishuAllowEntry
methods.description: Normalizes a raw Feishu allowlist entry by trimming, removing provider prefix, and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: resolveFeishuAllowlistMatch
methods.description: Resolves whether a sender matches the allowlist based on allowFrom entries and sender IDs.

methods.name: resolveFeishuGroupConfig
methods.description: Resolves the Feishu group configuration based on group ID, supporting wildcards and case-insensitive matching.

methods.name: resolveFeishuGroupToolPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves the tool policy configuration for a specific Feishu group.

methods.name: isFeishuGroupAllowed
methods.description: Determines if a Feishu group is allowed based on group policy and allowlist.

methods.name: resolveFeishuReplyPolicy
methods.description: Determines reply policy, including whether a mention is required, based on message context and configuration.
